The ONLY object equal to lw(2)≈1.337 at q₀ is the selection-rule formula itself ⇒ any 'test' that reaches 1.337 must route through the rule = CIRCULAR. lw(2) stays structurally untestable (no c=2 mass-CONSUMER) — confirms the prior audit.
